    priority_scores = harmonic * penalty_factor
    # Overfull bins get negative infinity priority
    priority_scores = np.where(remaining >= 0, priority_scores, -np.inf)
    return priority_scores

    priority_scores[perfect_fit] = 1000

    if np.any(~fits):
        priority_scores[~fits] = -10000 + remaining[~fits]
    return priority_scores
